prompt:
Look at the table in the image. It shows a card-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, a rounded outer frame, and a shaded header row. Use the source column to identify the winning row and transfer to the named target column. Determine the Temp value from the row whose Rank value is largest.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] with the decisive source extremum cell first and the transferred target value cell second.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact integer value from the transferred target cell.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":19}
